headline: Aluminium Relinquishes War Premium While Copper Prices Stay Elevated
summary: Base metals industry leaders gathered in London for LME Week 2026, noting that aluminium gave up its war premium while copper remained elevated amid energy transition demand.
why: The London Metal Exchange is the world center for industrial metal trading, reflecting global manufacturing and macroeconomic trends.

impacts.name: Copper
impacts.why: Sustained demand from the energy transition and green technology keeps copper prices elevated despite broader base metal shifts.
